name: Darkweave Crawler
description: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.

abilities.name: Minion (3)
abilities.description: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Skin-Crawling
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

abilities.name: Darkweave Venom
abilities.description: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to Exhaust the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.
